{{Capricorn}}
Capricorn 3 is the 31st day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 3rd day of Capricorn, and it is a Wednesday. It corresponds to ISO week 5, weekday 3.

Its informal Japanese name is 2宮3日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 31|Chapter 31]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152051}}.
